steps.desc: One explicitly selected package, compile-only; no guest execution
steps.cmd: set -eu; : "${LITEINST_BUILD_CHECKOUT:?set the writer-owned checkout}"; : "${LITEINST_BUILD_TARGET:?set a private external target directory}"; : "${LITEINST_BUILD_PACKAGE:?set the package to check}"; cd "$LITEINST_BUILD_CHECKOUT"; git rev-parse HEAD; git status --short; CARGO_TARGET_DIR="$LITEINST_BUILD_TARGET" CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=2 cargo check --locked --offline -j2 -p "$LITEINST_BUILD_PACKAGE" --lib
